newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: BA to move Mideast HQ to Dubai from Bahrain.
newsitem.headline: BA to move Mideast HQ to Dubai from Bahrain.

text.p: British Airways Plc plans to move its Middle East headquarters from Bahrain to Dubai in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) next year, a spokesman said on Thursday.
"British Airways is moving part of its Middle East regional offices, including (its) marketing office, to Dubai for operational reasons," the spokesman told Reuters.
The regional manager will now be based in Dubai.
"Dubai is a larger aviation market with more regional head offices of international airlines and it is important for us to be in constant contact with them.
"Dubai is also the location of a number of marketing service companies who work for British Airways and the move will help communications," the spokesman said.
The UAE emirate is a regional trade and re-export centre and its airport is the busiest in the Gulf.
